overview: ArthVeda Advisors advisory website — a frontend-only React site with a static blog authored as TypeScript data.
features: Public homepage with hero, services, about, contact, and latest articles sections
Blog listing with tag filtering by URL search param
Individual article pages with cover image, byline, and related articles
Articles authored as TypeScript data in src/frontend/src/data/articles.ts
SEO-ready: Open Graph tags, canonical URLs, JSON-LD structured data, sitemap
Light theme by default with a fully functional dark theme
